company.name: Officeworks
company.distributes: Workplace food and snacks: biscuits, confectionery, muesli bars, crackers, chips and nuts from brands such as Arnott's and Lotus Biscoff
company.channels_supplied: Own stores across Brisbane and Australia, online shop and business accounts for workplaces
what_they_do_well: Runs a dedicated workplace Food and Snacks range with biscuit, confectionery and muesli bar categories, including Arnott's portion packs.
company.fit_rationale: Australia's main office supplies retailer runs a Food and Snacks category for workplace kitchens with biscuits, confectionery and muesli bars from other brands, sold in portion packs and bulk. It reaches Brisbane offices through its stores and business accounts. Storage: sells from its own stores and online stock.

company.name: Perth Health
company.distributes: Chocolate (Loving Earth, Well Naturally), protein and snack bars (Quest, Blue Dinosaur), cookies (Lenny & Larry's), peanut butter and spreads (Byron Bay Peanut Butter), chewing gum and mints and other natural health and organic grocery from 200+ brands
company.channels_supplied: About 1,200 health food stores, pharmacies, organic and fresh provision outlets and independent grocers across metro, country and regional Western Australia
company.sf_brands_carried: Well Naturally (no added sugar chocolate), Quest, Slendier
what_they_do_well: Family owned and operated since 1984, the leading independent natural health wholesaler in Western Australia.
Covers metro, country and regional WA with next-day order turnaround for about 1,200 active customers.
company.fit_rationale: Family-owned wholesale distributor that sells over 3,000 products from 200+ other brands to about 1,200 WA retailers, with its own Chocolate, Snack Bars and Bites, Protein Bars and Spreads categories on its B2B shop. Well Naturally no added sugar chocolate is a direct competitor, but the range is wide enough to take Diablo's biscuits, sweets and spreads. Storage: B2B web shop with stock and next-day turnaround from its Balcatta premises; warehouse size not stated on its website.

company.name: Provender
company.distributes: Packaged snacks and lollies (sweets), healthy and special dietary snacks, drinks and fresh food through vending machines, smart fridges and micro markets
company.channels_supplied: Workplaces, retail sites and micro markets through local franchise teams in 14 Australian locations
company.sf_brands_carried: Healthy Options and Special Dietary Requirements ranges; brands not named on its website
what_they_do_well: Runs fully managed vending in 14 locations from Cairns to Tasmania through its local franchise network.
Member of the Australian Vending Association and recognised as a Top Franchise Australia 2025 for innovation and support.
company.fit_rationale: A national vending and micro market operator whose local teams stock and restock snacks and lollies in fully managed machines across 14 locations. Its healthy and special dietary categories suit Diablo's no added sugar sweets, biscuits and bars. Storage: sells from its own stock through local teams, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Red Dot
company.distributes: Confectionery: bagged lollies, chocolate, gift confectionery (Cadbury Roses and Toblerone gift pouches), novelty lollies and gum (Mentos, Warheads) and chips, alongside party and seasonal ranges
company.channels_supplied: About 40 Red Dot and Red Dot Home stores across Western Australia plus its online shop
what_they_do_well: Proudly WA owned and operated since 1992, with 40 stores and over 700 West Australian staff.
company.fit_rationale: WA-owned discount variety, party and seasonal chain with about 40 stores and a confectionery department that sells branded chocolate gift pouches and lollies from other brands. Its seasonal ranges (Halloween, Spring, party) suit Diablo's gift boxes, variety packs and advent calendars, and no sugar-free confectionery is shown, so Diablo would fill a gap.

company.name: Supplement Mart
company.distributes: Protein bars, protein cookies, chocolate bars and protein snacks from other brands (Quest, Body Science, Lenny and Larry's, Macro Mike, Maxine's, Musashi, Low Carb Emporium)
company.channels_supplied: 54 stores across WA, SA, VIC, NSW and QLD plus its online shop
company.sf_brands_carried: Low carb and low sugar bars and snacks (Low Carb Emporium, Quest, Legendary Foods)
what_they_do_well: Operates 54 stores across five states plus a click and collect warehouse.
company.fit_rationale: Sports nutrition chain with 54 stores, mostly in Western Australia, whose protein snacks section lists about 20 bar, cookie and snack brands from other companies. Diablo's cookies, bars and sugar-free chocolate suit its health-conscious shoppers. Head office city is not stated on its website.

company.name: The Market Grocer
company.distributes: Confectionery and chocolate (Fyna, Hugos, Mars, Maltesers, Twix, Hi Chew, Nerds, Swizzels, Big Lolly), kids confectionery, biscuits and cookies (Sunday Cookies), snacks, health and protein lines, nuts and pantry goods
company.channels_supplied: Independent specialty grocers and major supermarkets across Australia
company.sf_brands_carried: Health and protein section; Orgran gluten-free snacks. No sugar-free confectionery brand named
what_they_do_well: Supplies independent specialty grocers and major supermarkets across Australia from its own Homebush warehouse.
company.fit_rationale: A national grocery wholesaler that already lists a deep range of branded confectionery, chocolate, biscuits and snacks from other companies for independent grocers and supermarkets. Diablo's chocolate, sweets and biscuits would sit beside its health and protein section as a sugar-free option. Storage: own warehouse at Homebush, Sydney, with warehousing and distribution to retailers.

company.name: WHSmith Australia
company.distributes: Food, drink and confectionery alongside books and travel accessories
company.channels_supplied: Over 50 stores at airports, hospitals and railway stations (Melbourne, Sydney, Brisbane, Adelaide, Perth, Gold Coast)
what_they_do_well: Grew from its first Melbourne Airport store in 2010 to over 50 Australian stores.
company.fit_rationale: Travel and hospital convenience retailer with over 50 Australian stores that sells confectionery and snacks to travellers and hospital visitors. Diablo's sugar-free chocolate and sweets suit hospital shoppers who need lower sugar choices.

company.name: Zouki
company.distributes: Packaged snacks, drinks, gifts, flowers, magazines and everyday convenience items in its hospital convenience stores (Zouki Convenience and Convenience Plus)
company.channels_supplied: Patients, visitors and staff through convenience stores and retail precincts in hospitals such as the Royal Melbourne, Royal Women's and St George hospitals, across 34 sites in Victoria, NSW, Queensland and the ACT
what_they_do_well: Won the 10-year contract to run all retail outlets in the new Bendigo Health building, its 15th Victorian hospital contract.
Takes head leases for hospital retail precincts in Victoria, NSW and the ACT and runs them under its own store brands.
company.fit_rationale: Zouki holds head leases on whole hospital retail precincts and runs its own branded convenience stores, buying centrally for many hospital sites. Its convenience stores sell snacks and gifts to patients, visitors and staff, a natural shelf for sugar free sweets and chocolate. Sugar free brands carried are not named on its website.
